title: John Deere Z530M 54-Inch 24 HP Zero-Turn Riding Lawn Mower with Hydrostatic Transmission
description:
The
John Deere
Z530M Zero-Turn Riding Lawn Mower is built for homeowners who want powerful performance, precision cutting, and reliable durability for large residential lawns. Designed for efficiency and comfort, this zero-turn mower delivers smooth operation and professional-quality cutting results.
Powered by a 24 HP V-Twin engine, the Z530M provides strong and consistent performance for mowing, mulching, bagging, and towing applications. The 54-inch Accel Deep™ mower deck is constructed from durable 10-gauge steel and engineered to improve grass lift and airflow for a cleaner, more even cut.
The dual hydrostatic Tuff Torq® transmission system delivers smooth handling and precise zero-turn maneuverability around trees, landscaping, and obstacles. With a top forward speed of up to 8 MPH, this mower helps complete large mowing jobs efficiently.
For operator comfort, the mower features a ComfortGlide suspension seat with adjustable armrests, ergonomic controls, electric start, electric fuel gauge, hour meter, and convenient deck access for maintenance and cleaning.
Additional features include a foldable Roll-Gard™ rollover protection system (ROPS), retractable seat belt, and compatibility with the MowerPlus® app for monitoring mower performance and maintenance information.
Built for residential lawn care, the John Deere Z530M combines durability, comfort, and cutting performance in a premium zero-turn riding mower.
Key Specifications:
Brand: John Deere
Model: Z530M
Engine: 24 HP V-Twin
Engine Displacement: 726cc
Fuel Type: Gas
Cutting Width: 54 Inches
Deck Material: 10-Gauge Steel
Transmission: Dual Hydrostatic
Maximum Forward Speed: 8 MPH
Maximum Reverse Speed: 4 MPH
Cutting Height Range: 1″ – 4″
Number of Blades: 3
Fuel Tank Capacity: 4.5 Gallons
Start Type: Electric Start
Turning Radius: Zero Turn
Recommended Yard Size: 2–4 Acres
Product Weight: 780 lbs
Warranty: 4-Year / 300-Hour Limited Warranty
